papers.title: Race and Redistricting in Local Governments
papers.title_cn: 地方政府中的种族与选区重划
papers.abstract: Electoral maps translate residential geography into political representation, yet they have never been systematically measured for thousands of local governments across the country. We reconstruct 3,712 city council and county commission maps across 18,521 districts using nationwide voter-file and Census data. Enacted maps overrepresent White voters and underrepresent Black and Hispanic voters, with gaps predicting the racial composition of officeholders. We juxtapose these with simulated, race-blind maps satisfying common districting constraints. Simulated maps reproduce much of this disparity, showing that geography skews representation before any boundary-drawing. Enacted maps substantially improve on the race-blind baseline only in jurisdictions subject to oversight from the Voting Rights Act or districting litigation. As courts curtail race-conscious districting, local governments may revert to a baseline that is formally neutral but substantively unequal.
papers.abstract_cn: 选举地图将居住地理转化为政治代表，但全国数千个地方政府的选举地图从未进行过系统性测量。我们利用全国选民档案和人口普查数据，重建了遍布18,521个选区的3,712个城市议会和县委员会地图。实施的地图过度代表白人选民，而低估了黑人和西班牙裔选民，这些差距预测了官员的种族构成。我们将这些地图与满足常见选区划分约束的模拟、无视种族的地图进行对比。模拟地图复制了这种差异的大部分，表明在任何边界绘制之前，地理因素就扭曲了代表权。只有在受《投票权法》监督或选区划分诉讼的司法管辖区，实施的地图才在无视种族的基线基础上有了显著改进。随着法院限制基于种族的选区划分，地方政府可能会回归到表面上中立但实际上不平等的基线。

papers.title: Search and Negotiation with Biased Beliefs in Consumer Credit Markets
papers.title_cn: 消费者信贷市场中带有偏见信念的搜索与谈判
papers.abstract: How do biased beliefs about the interest rate distribution affect search, negotiation, and loan terms in consumer credit markets? In collaboration with Chile's financial regulator, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 112,063 loan seekers. Randomly eliciting beliefs about interest rates led participants to search more and obtain lower rates. Most participants underestimated both interest rate levels and dispersion. Showing them a price comparison tool we built using administrative data on the universe of consumer loans caused them to update their beliefs, negotiate more, obtain lower rates without searching more, and be more likely to take out a loan.
papers.abstract_cn: 对利率分布的偏见如何影响消费者信贷市场中的搜索、谈判和贷款条款？我们与智利金融监管机构合作，对112,063名贷款寻求者进行了随机对照试验。随机引导参与者表达对利率的信念，导致他们增加搜索并获取更低的利率。大多数参与者对利率水平和分散程度都有所低估。向他们展示我们使用涵盖所有消费者贷款的行政数据构建的价格比较工具，使他们更新了自己的信念，增加了谈判，获得了更低的利率而无需增加搜索，并更有可能获得贷款。

papers.title: Monopsony Makes it Big
papers.title_cn: 买方垄断势力的壮大
papers.abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific ("residual") labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm's labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
papers.abstract_cn: 近年来，劳动力市场中的不完全竞争文献迅速扩展。本文提供了该领域的指南，重点关注以企业特定（“残差”）劳动力供给弹性作为定义企业劳动力市场力量的指标。我们提出了一个通用框架，展示了这种弹性如何包含三个广泛研究的买方垄断力量来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调可能的异质性来源。我们强调，由于企业工资设定实践的多样性，很难从向下压低（反之亦然）推断出弹性，使用买方垄断与效率工资之间的相互作用来说明这一点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济政策问题如何与买方垄断相互作用，并以列出未来研究的几个领域作为结论。

papers.title: The Global Transition – The Impact of Demographics and AI on Economic Power
papers.title_cn: 全球转型——人口结构和人工智能对经济实力的影响
papers.abstract: This study deploys a multi-region, dynamic life-cycle, general equilibrium model to assess demography’s impact, through the course of this century, on global development. Our model’s 17 regions encompass more than 150 countries comprising 99% of the world’s population. Output is produced with three labor skill groups and internationally-mobile capital, with each country deciding annually whether to adopt its frontier automation technology. Our model features region-specific fiscal policy, TFP growth, and idiosyncratic mortality. Agents live for 100 years, first as children, then as workers, and then as retirees. Work and saving decisions are governed by CES preferences. Lifespan is uncertain, but there are no annuities apart from state pensions. Hence, bequests, while significant, are unintended. Our fertility, mortality, and net immigration rates are region- and age-specific and align fully with the UN’s projections. To illustrate demographics’ power to impact the global transition, we simulate our model under the UN’s markedly different demographic projections for 2017 and 2024. The 2024 forecast is particularly pessimistic about China’s fertility prospects. Both projections produce very substantial global aging, a major global capital glut producing very low long-run real capital returns. The latest forecast entails 10% lower global GDP in 2100 and far higher payroll tax rates to fund old-age benefits. Most important, it entails a major change in the course of economic hegemony with China’s 2100 global GDP share falling from 25.6% to 14.9% and the US share rising from 11.2% to 14.4%. Our results are sensitive. Should the US eliminate all future immigration, its 14.4% global 2100 GDP share would drop to 9.2%. And were global fertility to follow the UN’s low variant, 2100 world output would be one third, not one tenth lower. The level and division of global output is also highly sensitive to the speed at which AI expands frontier technologies. Accelerated AU/AI – 4x faster-than-recent growth in capital’s share through 2050 – or Transformative AU/AI – 10x faster capital-share growth – reinforce demographic forces, ensuring long-run US economic hegemony. Indeed, Transformative AI combined with 2024 demographics implies US and Chinese 2100 global GDP shares of 25.3% and 16.9%, respectively. And not withstanding its considerable technological catch up, the US retains, based on our calibration, a technological edge over China throughout the century.
papers.abstract_cn: 本研究运用一个多区域、动态生命周期、一般均衡模型来评估本世纪人口结构对全球发展的影响。我们的模型包含17个区域，涵盖了占世界人口99%的150多个国家。产出由三类不同技能水平的劳动力和国际流动的资本共同生产，每个国家每年都要决定是否采用其前沿自动化技术。模型中包含区域特定的财政政策、全要素生产率增长和个体特异性死亡率。经济主体寿命为100年，先是作为儿童，然后作为工作者，最后作为退休者。工作和储蓄决策受CES偏好的支配。寿命是不确定的，但除了国家养老金外没有年金。因此，遗产虽然重要，却是无意之中产生的。我们的生育率、死亡率和净移民率是区域和年龄特定的，并且完全符合联合国的预测。为了说明人口结构对全球转型的影响，我们在联合国2017年和2024年截然不同的人口预测下模拟了我们的模型。2024年的预测对中国的生育前景特别悲观。两种预测都产生了非常显著的全球老龄化，以及主要的全球资本过剩，导致长期实际资本回报率非常低。最新的预测意味着2100年全球GDP将降低10%，并且需要更高的工资税率来资助老年福利。最重要的是，它意味着经济霸权进程的重大变化，中国的2100年全球GDP份额从25.6%下降到14.9%，美国的份额从11.2%上升到14.4%。我们的结果很敏感。如果美国取消所有未来的移民，其14.4%的全球2100年GDP份额将下降到9.2%。如果全球生育率遵循联合国的低变体，2100年世界产出将降低三分之一，而不是十分之一。全球产出的水平和分配也高度依赖于人工智能扩展前沿技术的速度。加速的AU/AI——比最近增长快4倍的资本份额增长——或变革性的AU/AI——资本份额增长快10倍——加强了人口力量，确保了美国长期的经济霸权。实际上，变革性的AI结合2024年的人口结构意味着美国和中国2100年全球GDP份额分别为25.3%和16.9%。尽管技术迎头赶上，但根据我们的校准，美国在整个世纪中保持对中国的技术优势。

papers.title: Credit Card Banking
papers.title_cn: 信用卡银行业务
papers.abstract: Credit card interest rates currently average 22%, an 18% spread over the short rate. This spread far exceeds that on any other loan or bond, yet nearly half of households are credit card borrowers. Why are credit card rates so high? To understand this, and the economics of credit card banking, we use regulatory account-level data to analyze the lifetime cash flows of 550 million monthly accounts, representing 90% of the US credit card market. While charge-off rates are comparatively high, averaging around 6%, they explain only a fraction of cards' spread. Reward payments and non-interest expenses are more than offset by interchange and non-interest income. Operating expenses, particularly marketing, are very large, and are used to generate pricing power. Yet, after deducting them, card lending still earns a 6.8% return on assets (ROA), more than four times the banking sector's ROA. Using the cross section of accounts, we estimate that credit card rates price in a 4.3% default risk premium, similar to high-yield bonds. Accounting for this, card lending earns an alpha of around 1.5% relative to the aggregate bank sector.
papers.abstract_cn: 信用卡利率目前平均为22%，比短期利率高出18个百分点。这一利差远远超过了其他任何贷款或债券的利差，但几乎有一半的家庭是信用卡借款人。为什么信用卡利率如此之高？为了理解这一点以及信用卡银行业务的经济性，我们使用监管账户级数据来分析5.5亿个每月账户的终身现金流，这些账户代表了美国信用卡市场的90%。虽然核销率相对较高，平均约为6%，但它们只解释了信用卡利差的一小部分。奖励支付和非利息支出被交换费用和非利息收入所抵消。运营费用，特别是市场营销费用，非常大，并且被用来产生定价权。然而，在扣除这些费用后，信用卡贷款仍然获得了6.8%的资产回报率（ROA），是银行业ROA的四倍多。利用账户的横截面数据，我们估计信用卡利率定价了4.3%的违约风险溢价，与高收益债券相似。考虑到这一点，信用卡贷款相对于整个银行部门获得了约1.5%的超额收益（alpha）。

papers.title: Teen Suicide and the Outcomes of Surviving Peers
papers.title_cn: 青少年自杀与幸存同伴的结果
papers.abstract: By age 17, a quarter of U.S. students have experienced a peer suicide. Using linked administrative data from South Carolina and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that exposure to a peer's self-harm death increases the probability of a self-harm diagnosis by nearly 50% and both the incidence and frequency of mental health visits. Effects on care use and criminal behavior are concentrated among white boys, and responses diverge by prior mental health history: students without a prior diagnosis increase felony offending rather than care-seeking. Deaths from assault and transportation accidents produce no comparable rise in self-harm, consistent with contagion.
papers.abstract_cn: 到17岁时，四分之一的美国学生经历了同伴自杀。利用南卡罗来纳州的关联行政数据和匹配的双重差分设计，我们发现暴露于同伴自伤死亡事件中，会使得自伤诊断的概率增加近50%，同时心理健康状况就诊的发生率和频率也有所增加。对医疗使用和犯罪行为的影响主要集中在白人男孩中，且根据先前的心理健康状况，反应有所不同：没有先前诊断的学生更倾向于增加重罪犯罪而不是寻求医疗帮助。来自袭击和交通事故的死亡并没有导致自伤行为的类似增加，这与传染效应一致。

papers.title: Virtual Tutoring with Computer-Assisted Learning: An Experiment in Take-Up and Learning
papers.title_cn: 计算机辅助学习的虚拟辅导：一项关于申领和学习的实验
papers.abstract: We explore the efficacy of an online after-school tutoring program that complements teacher-provided computer-assisted learning practice. The aim is to scaffold students struggling with online Khan Academy practice at school with low-cost, one-on-one virtual supervision for about an hour a week at home. In a two-year randomized trial with the Toronto District School Board, teachers identified struggling Grade 4–8 students, whose parents were then randomly offered additional online tutoring to support their practice at home. The main obstacle was participation. Only 45% of assigned students reached a first session in Year 1. After we reframed the invitation and simplified enrollment, initial take-up in Year 2 rose to 83%, though weekly attendance remained below half—not because students dropped out, but because they attended intermittently. On average, the offer raised Khan Academy practice by about 10 minutes per week. This translated to an average gain in math assessment scores of 0.06 SD, with a confidence interval too wide to rule out null or medium-sized gains (ITT 0.055 SD; 95% CI [−0.09, 0.20]). We find a marginally significant gain in math report-card marks (about 0.08 SD; 95% CI [−0.01, 0.17]) and improvements in math satisfaction and enjoyment, with effects larger in Year 2 than in Year 1, consistent with the higher take-up that year. We therefore conclude that the program holds promise, but more is needed to ensure students actually engage with tutors on a regular basis.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个在线课后辅导项目的有效性，该项目补充了教师提供的计算机辅助学习练习。目标是通过每周大约一小时的低成本、一对一的虚拟监督，帮助在学校使用在线Khan Academy练习中遇到困难的学生。在与多伦多地区学校委员会进行的为期两年的随机试验中，教师识别出在4至8年级中挣扎的学生，然后随机向他们的家长提供额外的在线辅导，以支持他们在家中的练习。主要障碍是参与度。在第一年，只有45%的分配学生参加了第一次会议。在我们重新构思邀请并简化注册流程后，第二年的初始参与度上升到83%，尽管每周出勤率仍然低于一半——并不是因为学生退出，而是因为他们间歇性地参加。平均而言，提供辅导使Khan Academy练习增加了大约10分钟每周。这转化为数学评估分数的平均增长为0.06标准差，置信区间太宽，无法排除零效应或中等大小效应（意向性治疗0.055标准差；95%置信区间[-0.09, 0.20]）。我们发现数学成绩单分数有边际显著的增长（约0.08标准差；95%置信区间[-0.01, 0.17]），以及数学满意度和乐趣的提高，这些效应在第二年比第一年更大，与那一年更高的参与度一致。因此，我们得出结论，该项目是有希望的，但需要更多的工作来确保学生实际上定期与导师进行互动。

papers.title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
papers.title_cn: 生物多样性丧失的内在价值评估
papers.abstract: We explore the welfare costs of the loss of animal life in a consequentialist total utilitarian framework that incorporates the intrinsic value of living beings through their sentience. Moral philosophy and neuroscience define sentience as the capacity for valenced experience. Observable performance on cognitive tests represents a conservative lower bound on sentience under plausible neuroscientific assumptions. We estimate the relationship between cognition and neuron counts to cardinalize sentience. We collect population and neuron data for a wide range of animal species, and aggregate them into a single welfare measure. Across a wide range of parameters, the aggregate sentience losses of animals in the past half century outstrip the sentience gains to humans from population growth by at least 10,000-fold. Breaking even in welfare terms requires assigning a correspondingly small welfare weight to animals. Including the benefits of economic growth to humans does little to change these overall welfare losses.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们在一个包含生物感知能力内在价值的总效用主义框架内，探讨动物生命丧失的福利成本。道德哲学和神经科学将感知定义为具有情感体验的能力。在合理的神经科学假设下，认知测试的可观察表现代表了感知能力的保守下限。我们估计了认知与神经元数量之间的关系，以量化感知能力。我们收集了广泛动物种类的种群和神经元数据，并将它们汇总成一个单一的福利度量。在广泛的参数范围内，过去半个世纪动物的总体感知损失至少是人类因人口增长而获得的感知增益的10,000倍。要在福利方面实现平衡，需要给动物分配相应较小的福利权重。将经济增长对人类的益处包括在内，对这些总体福利损失的影响微乎其微。

papers.title: The Effects of Ads on Beliefs and Implications for Consumer Search
papers.title_cn: 广告对信念的影响及其对消费者搜索的启示
papers.abstract: We study how in-store display ads communicate information about a product’s price and quality, both directly through ad content and indirectly through inferences consumers draw from the presence and content of the ad. We run an incentivized experiment in a simulated online store, randomizing ad exposure, ad content, and the advertised product’s price, while also eliciting participants’ beliefs and choices. Display ads shift beliefs about price and quality, even when the ad copy does not directly reveal either attribute. We provide evidence that these belief shifts have a causal effect on searches and purchases of the advertised product. Using a stylized search model, we show that while visibility explains most of the ad effects, belief updating explains a statistically and economically significant share. Casting ad content choice as an information design problem, we show that advertisers may find it optimal to conceal product information even when it exceeds consumers’ expectations.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了店内展示广告如何通过广告内容直接传达产品的价格和质量信息，以及消费者从广告的存在和内容中间接推断出这些信息。我们在模拟的在线商店中进行了一项激励性实验，随机化了广告曝光、广告内容和广告产品的价格，同时也收集了参与者的信念和选择。即使广告文案没有直接透露这两个属性，展示广告也会改变对价格和质量的信念。我们提供的证据表明，这些信念的转变对搜索和购买广告产品有因果效应。利用一个风格化的搜索模型，我们展示了虽然可见性解释了大部分广告效应，但信念更新也解释了一个在统计和经济上都显著的份额。将广告内容选择视为一个信息设计问题，我们展示了广告商可能会发现即使产品信息超出消费者的预期，隐藏产品信息也是最优的。

papers.title: Idea Rents and Firm Growth
papers.title_cn: 创意租金与企业增长
papers.abstract: Which firms drive aggregate productivity growth? We document that firms with high price-earnings ratios tend to see increases in their subsequent earnings relative to sales, which we interpret as rents from ideas (innovation). We construct an endogenous growth model with shocks to firm innovation step-sizes and R&D efficiency and calibrate it to match patterns in the data. The model implies that growth would be much lower, even with the same innovative effort, if firms had the same step sizes. The model can be used to infer expected growth contributions of individual firms (such as members of the Magnificent Seven). We find that the share of growth coming from smaller listed firms substantially exceeds their sales share, whereas the largest listed firms account for less than their sales share.
papers.abstract_cn: 哪些企业推动了总体生产率增长？我们记录到，高市盈率的公司往往在随后的盈利相对于销售收入上有所增加，我们将其解释为来自创意（创新）的租金。我们构建了一个包含企业创新步长和研发效率冲击的内生增长模型，并校准它以匹配数据中的模式。该模型意味着，如果企业具有相同的步长，即使在相同的创新努力下，增长也会低得多。该模型可以用来推断个别企业（如“七大奇迹”成员）的预期增长贡献。我们发现，来自较小上市公司的增长份额大大超过了它们的销售份额，而最大的上市公司所占的增长份额则低于它们的销售份额。

papers.title: Dynamic Effects of Trade
papers.title_cn: 贸易的动态效应
papers.abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
papers.abstract_cn: 贸易带来的总量福利收益是国际经济学中的经典洞见之一。然而，这些传统的福利收益是静态的，即它们将某一时点的现有要素供给和生产技术视为既定。近期研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术革新随时间产生的动态效应，尽管关于这些动态效应的数量级仍不如对它们静态对应物的共识。这项研究的关键洞见包括：短期和长期对贸易自由化的响应不同；资本积累放大了国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易可以通过改变供应商的构成促进技术采纳和思想的传播；一旦考虑过渡动态，对终身福利的影响与对稳态福利的影响有显著差异；市场失灵可以放大贸易带来的总体福利收益，或为积极的贸易和产业政策提供合理化。

papers.title: Do Children Derail Women from the CEO Track?
papers.title_cn: 子女会阻碍女性走上CEO之路吗？
papers.abstract: Gender disparities in becoming a CEO are pronounced, and women who become CEOs, especially of large firms, are less likely to have children or be married. We study the effects of children and marriage on becoming a CEO, using longitudinal administrative data covering the universe of tax-registered firms in Costa Rica, matched to universal civil registry records that provide the timing of childbirth and marriage. We find that first childbirth is followed by a persistent decline in women’s probability of becoming a CEO, but no comparable decline for men and some evidence that CEO attainment rises. Marriage displays a different but still divergent pattern: it is associated with higher subsequent CEO attainment for men, but little change for women. Changes around childbirth account for a substantial share of the overall gender difference in CEO rates. Finally, we find evidence consistent with household specialization as a potential mechanism. Around marriage and first childbirth, women’s formal employment, earnings, and share of household earnings decline, while men become more central to household earnings as their partners reduce formal employment.
papers.abstract_cn: 成为首席执行官（CEO）的性别差异非常明显，尤其是成为大公司CEO的女性，她们更不可能有孩子或已婚。我们利用覆盖哥斯达黎加所有税务注册企业及其与全民登记记录匹配的纵向行政数据，研究了孩子和婚姻对成为CEO的影响，这些记录提供了生育和婚姻的时间信息。我们发现，首次生育后，女性成为CEO的可能性持续下降，但男性没有类似的下降，甚至有一些证据表明男性成为CEO的可能性上升。婚姻呈现出不同但仍然分歧的模式：它与男性随后成为CEO的可能性更高相关，但对女性几乎没有变化。生育前后的变化在总体性别差异中占有很大比例。最后，我们发现了与家庭专业化作为潜在机制一致的证据。在婚姻和首次生育前后，女性的正规就业、收入和家庭收入份额下降，而男性随着伴侣减少正规就业，成为家庭收入的更核心部分。

papers.title: Social Clubs and Political Office
papers.title_cn: 社交俱乐部与政治职位
papers.abstract: Elites maintain disproportionate political power even in formally inclusive political systems, yet the institutions through which they coordinate and reproduce this advantage remain poorly understood. We study membership in the Buenos Aires Jockey Club—Argentina's most prominent elite social club—exploiting staggered variation in family entry. Using difference-in-differences techniques, we find that Jockey Club membership increased the probability of holding legislative office by approximately four percentage points—more than twice the control-group mean. Consistent with a network-based mechanism, membership also increased families' centrality in elite marriage networks—a resource that can facilitate political success through access to party nominations and voter mobilization. This electoral advantage declines substantially after the 1912 Sáenz Peña democratizing reforms, suggesting that the political returns to club membership are conditional on institutional contexts that make elite network connections valuable. Our findings shed light on how elite social institutions reproduce political inequality where personal connections are essential for accessing political office.
papers.abstract_cn: 即使在形式上包容的政治体系中，精英阶层仍然保持着不成比例的政治权力，然而他们通过哪些机构协调并复制这种优势，这一点仍然不甚明了。我们研究了布宜诺斯艾利斯赛马俱乐部——阿根廷最杰出的精英社交俱乐部——的成员身份，利用家族进入时间的交错变化。通过使用双重差分技术，我们发现赛马俱乐部的成员身份将持有立法职位的概率提高了约四个百分点——超过对照组均值的两倍多。与基于网络的机制一致，成员身份还增加了家族在精英婚姻网络中的中心性——这一资源可以通过获得政党提名和动员选民来促进政治成功。在1912年Sáenz Peña民主化改革之后，这种选举优势大幅下降，这表明俱乐部成员身份的政治回报取决于使精英网络联系有价值的制度环境。我们的发现揭示了在个人联系对于获得政治职位至关重要的地方，精英社交机构如何复制政治不平等。

papers.title: Beliefs about Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
papers.title_cn: 关于政府债务估值与可持续性的信念
papers.abstract: What ultimately supports the market value of U.S. government debt? We measure valuation frameworks: the perceived channels that back debt value. We survey bond investors, registered voters, and economics or finance graduate-degree holders, asking them to allocate debt value across six sources derived from open-ended answers and the literature. Global safe-asset demand and permanent rollover together account for almost half of perceived value in every group, so debt value heavily relies on investor absorption rather than on government resources. Future primary surpluses, the textbook debt backing, receive about 16% even among the graduate-trained; roughly one-third say they provide little or no support. Allocations concentrate within respondents but disperse across them, forming belief archetypes that vary little with fiscal knowledge. A model shows why belief elicitation matters: identical debt quantities and price schedules can conceal differences in saleable public backing and stress-resilient demand, and therefore in debt sustainability. Concern about debt sustainability is widespread, and all three groups put the ten-year crisis odds near 50%. However, among respondents expressing concern, 90% of voters report that it is not decisive in their voting decisions, and 72% of investors report no concrete portfolio change.
papers.abstract_cn: 美国政府债务的市场价值最终由什么支撑？我们测量了估值框架：即被感知为支持债务价值的渠道。我们调查了债券投资者、注册选民以及持有经济学或金融学研究生学位的人，要求他们将债务价值分配到六个来源，这些来源是根据开放式回答和文献得出的。全球避险资产需求和永久性滚动再融资共同占到了每个群体感知价值的近一半，因此债务价值在很大程度上依赖于投资者的吸收，而不是政府资源。未来初级盈余，即教科书中提到的债务支持，即使在受过研究生训练的人群中也只能获得约16%的支持；大约三分之一的人表示它们提供的支持很少或没有。分配在受访者内部集中，但在他们之间分散，形成了信念原型，这些原型与财政知识的关系不大。一个模型显示了为什么信念引出很重要：相同的债务数量和价格表可能掩盖了可销售公共支持和抗压力需求的差异，因此也掩盖了债务的可持续性。对债务可持续性的关注普遍存在，所有三个群体都将十年危机的可能性定在接近50%。然而，在表示关注的人中，90%的选民报告说这并不是他们投票决策中决定性的因素，72%的投资者报告没有具体的投资组合变化。

papers.title: The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
papers.title_cn: 政府外包的局限性：印度的财产税重新评估
papers.abstract: Theories of outsourcing often presume that private firms are more efficient producers of goods and services, but that contracting frictions mean that firms do not internalize the government's objective function. But perhaps, for some tasks, the government can actually be more productively efficient? We study this question through an experiment in Chennai, India, where the government randomly selected neighborhoods to have property tax assessments determined by private firms contracted by the government, rather than government tax inspectors. We show that inspections by government tax inspectors yielded almost double the increase in tax revenue as those done by private firms. They were also more accurate, as judged by comparing new assessments to independent assessments done by third-party surveyors we hired. Difficulties contracting with the government discouraged many competent firms from bidding. Perhaps as a result, government inspectors had higher skills and put in more effort than the workers at the private firms. Importantly, the government inspectors also had more authority to enter properties, which may be hard to transfer even to higher quality firms. The results suggest that the limits to government outsourcing may go beyond multitasking issues.
papers.abstract_cn: 外包理论通常假定私营企业是更高效的商品和服务生产者，但由于合同摩擦，企业无法完全内化政府的目标函数。但是，对于某些任务，政府实际上可能更有生产效率吗？我们通过在印度金奈进行的一项实验来研究这个问题，政府随机选择一些社区，让政府签约的私营企业而非政府税务检查员来确定财产税评估。我们发现，政府税务检查员的检查使税收收入增加了近一倍，相比之下，私营企业所做的检查增加的税收收入较少。通过将新的评估与我们聘请的第三方调查员进行的独立评估进行比较，我们判断政府税务检查员的评估也更为准确。与政府签约的困难使得许多有能力的企业不愿投标。可能因此，政府检查员拥有更高的技能，并且比私营企业的员工投入了更多的努力。重要的是，政府检查员还拥有更大的权力进入财产，这种权力可能很难甚至转移到更高质量的企业。结果表明，政府外包的局限性可能超出了多任务处理问题。

papers.title: Outside Options and Labor Supply: Evidence from the Gig Economy
papers.title_cn: 外部选择与劳动力供给：来自零工经济的证据
papers.abstract: We use randomized pay experiments among Uber drivers, paired with a natural experiment in access to a competitor, to examine how outside options shape labor supply to the firm. When hours are flexible, the firm-specific labor supply elasticity combines a market-hours component and a firm-substitution component. Access to a single competing platform nearly doubles drivers’ firm-specific elasticity and cuts the implied monopsony markdown from 68% to about 50%. The same experiments identify sex differences: women are about twice as elastic to the market as men, yet no less elastic to their employer.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们利用针对Uber司机的随机支付实验，结合对竞争对手平台访问权限的自然实验，来检验外部选择如何塑造对公司的劳动力供给。当工作时间灵活时，特定于公司的劳动力供给弹性结合了市场工时部分和公司替代部分。访问单一竞争平台几乎使司机对公司的特定弹性翻倍，并将暗示的买方垄断折扣从68%降低到大约50%。同样的实验还识别出了性别差异：女性对市场的弹性大约是男性的两倍，但对雇主的弹性并不小于男性。

papers.title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
papers.title_cn: 在溢出效应实验中的鲁棒信号最大化
papers.abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases -- such as clustered exposure-- and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了估计溢出效应的实验设计和分析的最优方法。假设已知（例如，线性）暴露映射，我们描述了在广泛的不可观测变量分布下，最小化最坏情况下渐近方差的处理分配分布和基于回归的估计器。设计问题产生了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者在溢出信号强度和溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题产生了一个简单的重新中心化的仪器变量估计器，以最好地利用这种变异。这个框架在几个基准案例中产生了自然的解决方案——例如，聚集暴露——并为包括二分图设置在内的一般网络提出了计算上可行的近似方法。我们在基于发展经济学中两个应用的半合成实验中展示了这些新工具。我们的方法在两个实验中都大幅降低了标准误差，有效样本量增加了50-100%或更多。

papers.title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
papers.title_cn: 国内外包的替代效应
papers.abstract: Evidence that domestic outsourcing lowers pay comes largely from on-site transfers, in which workers move to a contractor but keep the same jobs. Displacement is rarely observed: whether workers lose their jobs, where they go, how earnings evolve. In Brazil’s 1993–1994 pro-outsourcing reforms, which differentially affected security guards, such transfers were rare; firms instead used occupational layoffs, shedding their guards while keeping other workers. Displaced guards’ employment recovered within five years, but many changed occupations and wages stayed about 12% lower. Lifetime losses average 1.2 to 1.5 years of pre-layoff earnings, concentrated among workers from high-wage firms, reflecting lost premia.
papers.abstract_cn: 国内外包降低工资的证据主要来自现场转移，即工人转移到承包商那里，但保持相同的工作。很少观察到置换：工人是否失去工作，他们去了哪里，收入如何演变。在巴西1993-1994年支持外包的改革中，这种转移很少见；企业反而使用职业裁员，裁减他们的保安人员，同时保留其他工人。被置换的保安人员的就业在五年内恢复，但许多人改变了职业，工资仍然低约12%。终身损失平均为1.2至1.5年的裁员前收入，主要集中在高工资公司的工人中，反映了失去的溢价。

papers.title: A Currency Premium Puzzle
papers.title_cn: 货币溢价之谜
papers.abstract: We show that quantitative asset pricing models, built to address the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles, systematically fail when applied to open economies: they cannot generate the large and persistent interest rate differentials we observe between risky and safe currencies. This failure stems from the key mechanism that produces their success in matching both closed-economy puzzles: In these models, the mean of the stochastic discount factor offsets its variance nearly one-for-one, which immobilizes interest rates --- so that differences in expected currency returns across countries must arise almost exclusively from predictable changes in exchange rates, at odds with the data. We prove this result in a broad class of models that allows for market incompleteness and exchange rate disconnect, requiring only that each country's risk-free asset is priced by investors who demand compensation for risk in line with observed risk premia. We argue this tension between canonical asset pricing and international macroeconomic models is a key reason researchers have struggled to reconcile the observed behavior of exchange rates, interest rates, and capital flows across countries.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们发现，旨在解决股权溢价和无风险利率之谜的数量型资产定价模型，在应用于开放经济体时系统性地失败：它们无法产生我们观察到的风险货币和安全货币之间巨大且持久的利率差异。这种失败源于在封闭经济体中匹配这两个谜题时产生成功的主要机制：在这些模型中，随机折现因子的均值几乎一对一地抵消了其方差，这使得利率无法移动——因此，不同国家预期货币收益率的差异几乎完全来自于可预测的汇率变化，这与数据不符。我们在允许市场不完全性和汇率脱节的广泛模型类别中证明了这一结果，仅要求每个国家无风险资产的定价由要求与观察到的风险溢价一致的风险补偿的投资者来完成。我们认为，这种经典资产定价和国际宏观经济模型之间的张力是研究人员在解释观察到的汇率、利率和资本流动行为方面一直难以调和的关键原因。

papers.title: Do Children's Genes Evoke Educational Expectations? Direct Genetic Effects on Parents' and Teachers' College Encouragement
papers.title_cn: 儿童的基因是否引发教育期望？直接影响父母和教师对大学鼓励的遗传效应
papers.abstract: Parents’ and teachers’ expectations and aspirations are critical drivers of educational outcomes, yet what causally shapes these expectations remains unclear. In the present study, we address this question by deploying the random experiment of meiosis: namely, conditional on parental genotype, offspring genotype is random, allowing for the unconfounding of unique child characteristics from the more general family and household environment. Using the Wisconsin Longitudinal Study, we employ Mendelian imputation to estimate the direct genetic effects of 18 polygenic indices on college encouragement, net of parental genetic background. The genetic propensity for educational attainment and mathematical ability predict stronger expectations of college attendance, while smoking behavior predicts weaker expectations. Psychiatric traits show no effects after multiple-testing correction, indicating that responses are concentrated on cognitive and behavioral traits. Mediation analysis finds that prospectively measured teachers’ encouragement accounts for roughly a quarter of the genetic effects on educational attainment for cognitive traits, but not for psychiatric traits. Genetic effects on expectations are amplified among high-SES parents and first-born children. Thus, genetic influences on educational expectations are narrow in trait scope and uneven across families, with encouragement serving as one channel linking genetic differences to educational inequality.
papers.abstract_cn: 父母和教师的期望与抱负是教育成果的关键驱动因素，然而这些期望是如何被因果塑造的仍然不清晰。在当前研究中，我们通过部署减数分裂的随机实验来解决这个问题：即在父母基因型的基础上，后代基因型是随机的，这允许我们将独特的儿童特征从更广泛的家庭和家庭环境中分离出来。利用威斯康星纵向研究，我们采用孟德尔遗传推算来估计18个多基因指数对大学鼓励的直接遗传效应，排除了父母遗传背景的影响。教育成就和数学能力的遗传倾向预测了对大学入学的更强期望，而吸烟行为则预测了较弱的期望。在多重测试校正后，精神特征没有显示出影响，表明反应集中在认知和行为特征上。中介分析发现，前瞻性测量的教师鼓励大约解释了认知特征上教育成就的遗传效应的四分之一，但对于精神特征则没有。遗传效应在高社会经济地位（SES）父母和第一个孩子中被放大。因此，遗传对教育期望的影响在特征范围上是狭窄的，在不同家庭中是不均匀的，鼓励是将遗传差异与教育不平等联系起来的一个渠道。

papers.title: How Steep is the Phillips Curve in Developing Economies? A Sufficient Statistics Approach and Estimates for India
papers.title_cn: 发展中国家的菲利普斯曲线有多陡峭？一个充分统计方法及对印度的估计
papers.abstract: We estimate the Phillips curve for India to shed light on the output-inflation tradeoff in developing economies. We develop a method to estimate the slope of the Phillips curve based on sufficient statistics that apply to a broad class of New Keynesian models. Using portable causal research designs, we estimate the firm-level passthrough of cost shocks into prices at different horizons, and the slope of marginal cost curves at different levels of aggregation. These empirical moments map into the slope of the Phillips curve and yield a decomposition into three terms: price rigidity, micro real rigidities, and macro real rigidities. The slope of the Phillips curve in India is one order of magnitude steeper than in the United States. This difference is explained by weaker macro real rigidities and less rigid prices. Extending the model to allow for input misallocation, we find that the re-allocative effects of monetary policy affect the Phillips curve, but this effect is small.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们对印度的菲利普斯曲线进行估计，以阐明发展中国家中产出与通胀之间的权衡。我们开发了一种基于充分统计量的方法来估计菲利普斯曲线的斜率，这些统计量适用于广泛的新凯恩斯主义模型。利用可携带的因果研究设计，我们估计了不同时间范围内成本冲击向价格的企业级传导，以及不同聚合水平下边际成本曲线的斜率。这些实证时刻映射到菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并分解为三个部分：价格粘性、微观实际刚性以及宏观实际刚性。印度的菲利普斯曲线斜率比美国陡峭一个数量级。这种差异可以通过较弱的宏观实际刚性和较不僵硬的价格来解释。将模型扩展以允许投入错配，我们发现货币政策的再分配效应影响菲利普斯曲线，但这种效应很小。

papers.title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks, Bonds (and Options), Redux
papers.title_cn: 股票、债券（及期权）回报中的共同风险因素：再探
papers.abstract: We identify a strong common risk factor structure that is pervasive across corporate securities: stocks, corporate bonds, and options. The common factors are closely linked to observable factors and key economic indicators. These factors explain much of the variation in individual asset returns, although pricing errors persist. A joint mean-variance efficient portfolio across asset classes achieves a high Sharpe ratio, resulting in part from cross-market hedging of the common sources of risk. We develop a measure of market segmentation based on differences in the common factor risk premia between markets and document a significant degree of segmentation.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们发现了一个在公司证券中普遍存在的强大共同风险因子结构：股票、公司债券和期权。这些共同因子与可观察因子和关键经济指标密切相关。这些因子解释了个别资产回报的大部分变化，尽管定价误差仍然存在。一个跨资产类别的联合均值-方差有效投资组合实现了高夏普比率，部分原因是跨市场对冲共同风险来源。我们基于市场间共同因子风险溢价的差异开发了一种市场分割度量，并记录了显著程度的市场分割。

papers.title: Reconstructing a Century of U.S. Corporate Bonds: Credit Risk in Historical Perspective
papers.title_cn: 重建一个世纪的美国公司债券：历史视角下的信用风险
papers.abstract: Do corporate bond investors earn compensation for bearing credit risk? We construct a new historical corporate bond database spanning 128 years to estimate a corporate bond counterpart to the equity risk premium. Combining hand-collected archival data with modern sources, we assemble a panel of over 100,000 bonds and 7 million observations. While recent samples suggest corporate bond excess returns largely reflect the term premium, our long sample reveals a sizable and statistically significant credit risk premium. Credit spreads predict future corporate bond returns and macroeconomic aggregates, though their ability to forecast business cycle fluctuations weakens when prewar data are included.
papers.abstract_cn: 企业债券投资者是否因承担信用风险而获得补偿？我们构建了一个跨越128年的新历史企业债券数据库，以估算企业债券相对于股票风险溢价的对应物。结合手工收集的档案数据和现代数据源，我们汇编了一个包含超过100,000个债券和700万条观察值的面板数据集。尽管近期样本表明企业债券超额回报主要反映了期限溢价，但我们的长期样本揭示了一个庞大且统计显著的信用风险溢价。信用利差预测未来企业债券回报和宏观经济总量，尽管当包括战前数据时，其预测商业周期波动的能力会减弱。

papers.title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
papers.title_cn: 双边主权债务的风险
papers.abstract: Motivated by the emergence of new official creditors outside the Paris Club framework, we study the interaction between senior official lending and market debt. We develop a quantitative sovereign default model featuring a large senior lender with whom borrowing terms are negotiated. Obtaining more net financing from the market strengthens the government’s bargaining position and improves bilateral terms. This endogenous cross-elasticity erodes the discipline of spreads and amplifies debt dilution, leading to welfare losses even as bilateral borrowing helps avert some defaults ex-post. With pre-specified rules, rewarding market issuance can be enough to generate such losses, and an optimal rule instead raises bilateral rates with net market financing. The direction of the cross-elasticity can thus guide in practice the assessment of new forms of bilateral sovereign debt.
papers.abstract_cn: 受巴黎俱乐部框架外新官方债权人出现的影响，我们研究了高级官方贷款与市场债务之间的相互作用。我们开发了一个定量的主权违约模型，该模型以一个大型高级债权人为特色，与之协商借款条件。从市场获得更多的净融资加强了政府的议价能力，并改善了双边条款。这种内生的交叉弹性侵蚀了利差的纪律，并放大了债务稀释，导致即使双边借款有助于避免一些事后违约，也会出现福利损失。有了预先规定的规则，奖励市场发行就足以产生这种损失，而最优规则则是随着市场净融资的增加而提高双边利率。因此，交叉弹性的方向实际上可以指导对新型双边主权债务的评估。

papers.title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
papers.title_cn: 投资以节约：路易斯安那州根除丙型肝炎的订阅模式
papers.abstract: How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.
papers.abstract_cn: 支付方应如何平衡财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间的矛盾？我们研究了2019年路易斯安那州针对丙型肝炎（HCV）的医疗补助订阅模式，这是美国州政府首次采用两段式收费以确保对治愈性药物的无限访问。通过比较HCV患者与糖尿病或HIV患者的支出，使用双重差分设计，我们发现治疗量增加了三倍，医疗支出下降，新的HCV诊断减少了23%。该州在抗病毒药物上的额外支出3700万美元，在五年内节省了2.66亿美元。创新的融资模式可以为支付方带来健康效益和近期节省。

papers.title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_cn: 分阶段访问与双重用途人工智能的责任
papers.abstract: How should regulators combine staged access to a dual-use AI model with developer liability? I model a defender and an adversary searching for the same software flaws. After release, liability induces more defensive search but also makes the adversary search harder, limiting its effect on harm. Exclusive access removes this strategic response, so staged access and liability are complements in protection. Defensive effort rises towards the release date, making additional delay progressively less productive. Optimal evaluation windows are therefore bounded, and their response to greater harm saturates. Because defensive search uses real resources, the efficient liability rate can be below full internalisation of harm. That rate generally cannot induce the developer to choose the regulator's preferred release date, leaving a distinct role for a timing mandate.
papers.abstract_cn: 监管机构应如何结合阶段性访问双用途人工智能模型与开发者责任？我构建了一个模型，模拟防御者和对手寻找相同的软件漏洞。发布后，责任制度促使更多的防御性搜索，但也使得对手搜索更加困难，限制了其对伤害的影响。独家访问消除了这种策略反应，因此阶段性访问和责任在保护上是互补的。防御性努力随着发布日期的临近而增加，使得额外的延迟逐渐变得效率低下。因此，最优评估窗口是有限的，并且它们对更大伤害的反应会趋于饱和。由于防御性搜索使用了真实资源，有效的责任率可能低于完全内部化伤害。这个比率通常无法促使开发者选择监管机构偏好的发布日期，留下了对发布时间规定的独特作用。

papers.title: Fortunate Sons: Elite Political Selection in American History
papers.title_cn: 幸运之子：美国历史上的精英政治选拔
papers.abstract: We trace the family origins of Members of Congress (MC) born between 1830 and 1950, linking each MC, their parents, and their brothers to the complete-count censuses. Future MCs have always been economic outliers. By 1940, close to 60 percent of MCs aged 18--40 held a college degree, against under 5 percent of comparable young men outside Congress. In the 19th-century censuses, MCs as adults held roughly three times the wealth of demographically matched controls. They also come from economically elite families: their fathers earn more, attain more education, and hold more wealth. The brothers of future MCs sit between the population and the MCs themselves. Across the socioeconomic measures we compare, we calculate that roughly half of an MC's adult premium is shared with his brother and the other half is his own. Even as the American economy and political system have changed, the family background gap has widened over the last century and a half. Wealth, household servants, and four separate occupation-based scores all show the gap holding or growing across cohorts. We study four Progressive-Era reforms in a triple-difference design---women's suffrage, the secret ballot, direct primaries, and the direct election of senators---and none produce detectable shifts in who reaches Congress. Our results document a Congress drawn from the most fortunate families in American society in every cohort we observe.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们追溯了1830年至1950年间出生的国会议员（MC）的家庭起源，将每位MC、他们的父母和兄弟与完整统计的人口普查数据相联系。未来的MCs一直是经济上的异常者。到1940年，18至40岁的MC中近60%拥有大学学位，而国会外同龄男性中这一比例不到5%。在19世纪的人口普查中，成年MCs的财富大约是人口统计匹配对照组的三倍。他们也来自经济精英家庭：他们的父亲收入更高、教育程度更高、财富更多。未来MCs的兄弟在普通人群和MCs本人之间。在我们比较的社会经济指标中，我们计算出MC成年后的优势大约有一半与其兄弟共享，另一半属于他们自己。即使在美国经济和政治体系发生变化的情况下，过去一个半世纪以来，家庭背景差距一直在扩大。财富、家庭仆人和四个基于职业的得分都显示出这一差距在各个队列中保持或增长。我们采用三重差分设计研究了进步时代的四项改革——妇女选举权、秘密投票、直接初选和参议员直接选举——这些改革都没有产生可检测的变化，影响谁能够进入国会。我们的结果记录了我们观察到的每一个队列中，国会都是由美国社会最幸运的家庭所构成。

papers.title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
papers.title_cn: 智能体式人工智能与计量经济学编码中的提示工程
papers.abstract: We study how large language models write code for econometric analysis. We compare three dimensions of AI-assisted coding: statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), prompting (zero-shot versus few-shot), and the degree of agency, from a chatbot that writes a single script to an agent that executes and revises its own code. On a benchmark of applied econometric and statistical tasks, moving from the chatbot to the constrained agent raises task success from 74 to 96 percent, at about eight additional cents per run. For Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 through Codex, few-shot prompting improves the chatbot far more than the constrained agent, indicating that prompting and agency act as substitutes. For these models, differences across statistical software are sizeable under the chatbot but largely disappear under the constrained agent.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了大型语言模型如何编写用于计量经济学分析的代码。我们比较了人工智能辅助编码的三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R或Python）、提示（零次提示与少量提示）以及代理程度，从一个编写单一脚本的聊天机器人到一个执行并修订自己代码的智能体式人工智能。在应用于计量经济学和统计任务的基准测试中，从聊天机器人到受限智能体式人工智能，任务成功率从74%提高到96%，每次运行成本增加约八美分。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和通过Codex的GPT-5.4，少量提示对于聊天机器人的提升远大于受限智能体式人工智能，表明提示和智能体式人工智能作用可以相互替代。对于这些模型，在聊天机器人下不同统计软件之间的差异相当大，但在受限智能体式人工智能下基本消失。

papers.title: The Value Gap: Europe Cannot Scale
papers.title_cn: 《价值差距：欧洲无法实现规模化》
papers.abstract: In 2008, the aggregate market value of U.S.-listed firms was roughly one-third higher than that of European-listed firms. By 2023, it was more than 300% higher, a difference of $34 trillion. The valuation gap is broad-based, rather than concentrated among a few superstar firms, and is driven by differences in firm values, not in the number of listed firms. Across sectors, the gap is larger in R&D-intensive industries and in industries with high returns to scale. European firms’ size is strongly correlated with home-country GDP, whereas U.S. firms’ size is unrelated to home-state GDP. Smaller European firms also face a particularly large cost-of-capital gap and do not appear able to substitute debt for limited access to equity financing, including venture capital. Taken together, these facts suggest that financial and product-market frictions constrain European firms’ ability to scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 2008年，美国上市公司的总市值大约比欧洲上市公司高出三分之一。到了2023年，这一差距扩大到300%以上，差额达到34万亿美元。估值差距是普遍存在的，而不是集中在少数超级明星公司，它是由公司价值的差异驱动的，而不是上市公司数量的差异。在各个行业之间，研发密集型行业和规模经济回报高的行业的估值差距更大。欧洲公司的规模与母国GDP强相关，而美国公司的规模与母州GDP无关。规模较小的欧洲公司还面临特别大的资本成本差距，并且似乎无法用债务替代有限的股权融资，包括风险投资。综合这些事实，它们表明金融市场和产品市场摩擦限制了欧洲公司扩大规模的能力。

papers.title: AI Financial Advice: Supply, Demand, and Life Cycle Implications
papers.title_cn: 人工智能金融咨询：供给、需求与生命周期影响
papers.abstract: We ask a representative sample to write prompts seeking spending and investing advice from LLMs, then simulate the lifetime effects of following the advice under realistic asset and labor market conditions. Applying this method to GPT-5.2, we find following the advice would move respondents toward life cycle theory: broader participation in diversified equity funds, age-declining equity shares, and larger savings buffers. Recommendations vary systematically by gender, prior AI experience, and financial literacy. For gender, two-thirds of recommended equity-share differences arise from men and women writing different prompts (demand), while one-third arise from gender labels attached to otherwise identical prompts (supply).
papers.abstract_cn: 我们要求代表性样本编写提示，向大型语言模型（LLMs）寻求消费和投资建议，然后模拟在现实的资产和劳动力市场条件下遵循这些建议的终身影响。将这种方法应用于GPT-5.2，我们发现遵循这些建议会使受访者更接近生命周期理论：更广泛地参与多样化的股票基金，随着年龄增长股票份额下降，以及更大的储蓄缓冲。建议因性别、之前的AI经验和金融素养而系统性地变化。对于性别而言，推荐的股权份额差异中有三分之二源于男性和女性编写不同的提示（需求），而三分之一源于附加在其他方面相同的提示上的性别标签（供给）。

papers.title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
papers.title_cn: 不孕周期：跨代传递与辅助生殖的作用
papers.abstract: This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.
papers.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了同一家庭内不同代际之间生育相关问题的持续性，以及辅助生殖技术（ART）的使用情况。利用瑞典全面的注册数据，我们记录了生育困难在女儿和儿子之间显著的代际传递现象，这一现象独立于父母的社会经济地位。父母报告存在此类问题的女儿，自身经历生育问题的可能性高出2.6个百分点，即增加了19.4%。父母报告生育困难的儿子，其经历生育问题的可能性增加了1.7个百分点，即增加了13.5%。这些关联在不同的度量和样本中持续存在。比较在相同家庭中抚养的亲生和领养子女，我们发现这一现象不太可能由家庭对生育问题的认知所驱动，这指向了生物学因素以及其他亲生子女与父母共有而领养子女没有的因素。医疗技术对使用者同样有效，我们发现先进的生育治疗成功率与父母背景之间没有显著关联。然而，前代的生育困难与更高的医疗费用和社会成本相关，例如离婚的可能性增加。

papers.title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
papers.title_cn: 谨慎的职业：不完全市场中的工作流动性
papers.abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
papers.abstract_cn: 工作流动性具有风险，工人厌恶风险，而保险市场又不完善。本文研究了这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间的转换：他们在工作安全与工资和生产率增益之间赋予了过多的权重。我们通过在一项定制的代表性调查中引出在职工人的工资-安全无差异曲线来展示这种权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求在新工作中每增加一个百分点的年度失业风险，就需要1.63%的工资增长。我们通过将我们的机制嵌入到一般均衡搜索模型中来评估其宏观经济后果。工作在工资（生产率）和失业风险方面存在差异，而风险规避的工人则通过一种非状态依赖的债券在工作搜寻过程中自我保险以抵御失业风险。我们发现，一个完全市场的情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险较高但生产率较高的工作机会，从而提高生产率（1.3%）和创造就业机会——以及工作流失和失业。

papers.title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
papers.title_cn: 财产税和金融约束下的住房配置
papers.abstract: Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.
papers.abstract_cn: 低房产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭的住房获取。提高房产税可以通过两个渠道重新分配住房给年轻人：资本化导致房价下降，减少了融资约束买家所需的首付，这是一种内嵌的杠杆形式，同时更高的税收义务增加了老年业主的持有成本。在我们的跨代模型中，将加利福尼亚州的房产税提高到德克萨斯州的水平，可以增加年轻房主的拥有率，同时减少老年房主的拥有率。取消基差上调同样降低了老年房主的拥有率，这表明他们的居住权是由遗产税优势维持的。住房的税收处理方式塑造了跨代的住房分配。

papers.title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
papers.title_cn: 在变暖的世界中平衡增长
papers.abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文在一个综合评估框架内发展了一种平衡增长和最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，但平衡增长仍然是可能的，只是增长速度会较慢。由于排放永久性地增加了碳存量，因此出现了两种不同的政策制度。对于低损害，最优增长与自由放任相一致，碳定价保持恒定。对于高损害，最优政策通过限制温度增长来防止损失升级，并通过以递增的速率定价碳来实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们量化了我们的模型，并展示了实证损害估计涵盖了这两种制度。对于低损害，最优政策实现了1%的福利收益，每世纪升温3至8°C，长期增长没有变化。对于高损害，最优政策将年增长率提高了0.8个百分点，并通过将每世纪升温限制在0.4°C，实现了26%的福利收益。

papers.title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
papers.title_cn: 收入冲击与家庭内部动态：来自一项保障性收入实验的证据
papers.abstract: When an individual's income changes, it can affect their entire household. We study the intrahousehold effects of an unconditional cash transfer in which 1,000 individuals were randomly selected to receive a $1,000 per month transfer for three years, while a control group of 2,000 participants received $50 per month over the same time period. We find no effects on aggregate measures of household stability, although there is suggestive evidence of improved relationship quality and greater trust in partners among recipients in relationships. Transfers to friends and family increase, consistent with recipients sharing some of the additional income with others. There are also spillovers on the income and employment-related outcomes of other household members: household income excluding the recipient decreases by about $1,700 per year, and partners are less likely to be promoted or to move to a better job. Other household members are significantly more likely to participate in education or training, and recipients are also more likely to report someone in their household having to forgo healthcare, potentially reflecting greater engagement with the healthcare system and the identification of previously unmet needs. We observe limited changes in decision-making power or division of labor within the household. Some indicators of intimate partner violence decline, particularly for women, but reported incidence is low and most estimates do not remain statistically significant after adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing. Subgroup differences are generally imprecise, although point estimates suggest larger education and health spillover effects when the recipient is a woman. Household structure also appears to mediates the impacts of the transfers.
papers.abstract_cn: 当一个人的收入发生变化时，可能会影响整个家庭。我们研究了无条件现金转移支付对家庭内部的影响，其中随机选择了1000名个体，每月获得1000美元的转移支付，为期三年，而对照组的2000名参与者在同一时期每月获得50美元。我们发现对家庭稳定性的总体衡量没有影响，尽管有迹象表明，在关系中的接受者中，关系质量和对伴侣的信任有所提高。对朋友和家人的转移支付增加，这与接受者与他人分享部分额外收入是一致的。此外，对其他家庭成员的收入和就业相关结果也有溢出效应：不包括接受者在内的家庭收入每年减少约1700美元，伴侣晋升或换到更好工作的可能性降低。其他家庭成员更有可能参与教育或培训，接受者也更有可能报告家庭中有人不得不放弃医疗保健，这可能反映了与医疗保健系统的更多接触和之前未满足需求的识别。我们观察到家庭内部决策权或劳动分工的变化有限。亲密伴侣暴力的一些指标有所下降，特别是对女性而言，但报告的发生率很低，大多数估计在多重假设检验调整后不再具有统计学意义。子群差异通常不精确，尽管点估计表明，当接受者是女性时，教育和健康溢出效应更大。家庭结构似乎也调节了转移支付的影响。

papers.title: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
papers.title_cn: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持的动态变化
papers.abstract: Union growth has historically happened in spurts. We combine union election data from 1961–2025 with a large-scale information experiment involving 9,000 low-wage workers to study the role of social learning in union growth. Observationally, close election wins cause future wins within state-industries. Experimentally, information about recent union wins increases union support and beliefs about co-worker support, with effects concentrated among workers with weak information environments and low baseline coworker support. In contrast, information about labor market tightness has little effect. Our results highlight social learning as a mechanism for union growth.
papers.abstract_cn: 工会增长历来是间歇性的。我们将1961年至2025年的工会选举数据与涉及9000名低薪工人的大规模信息实验相结合，研究社会学习在工会增长中的作用。从观察结果来看，接近的选举胜利会导致未来在州-行业内的胜利。实验性地，关于近期工会胜利的信息增加了对工会的支持和对同事支持的信念，这些效应集中在信息环境薄弱和基线同事支持低的工人中。相比之下，关于劳动力市场紧张度的信息几乎没有影响。我们的结果强调了社会学习作为工会增长的一个机制。

papers.title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
papers.abstract: In this paper, we characterize trends in the earnings assimilation of immigrant workers from 1981 to 2021. We use administrative longitudinal data that contain the earnings of workers beginning in their first year of residence in the United States and in each year thereafter, allowing us to identify immigrants who eventually leave the United States (referred to here as return migrants). We use those data to produce the first examination of trends in earnings assimilation over a 41-year period and to estimate earnings assimilation separately for return migrants versus those who stay in the United States. We document several new facts about immigrants who arrived between 1981 to 2010. First, roughly one-fifth to one-third of immigrants return migrate from the United States within 10 years after arrival. Second, return migrants have entry earnings similar to those of permanent migrants but experience slower rates of earnings growth. Third, earnings assimilation occurs relatively quickly for cohorts arriving since the mid-1990s: The earnings of permanent immigrants converge, or come close to converging, with those of native-born people within 10 years after arrival. Migrants from earlier arrival cohorts experience significant earnings growth but generally do not converge to that of the native born. We discuss how changes in the labor market quality of immigrant cohorts (measured by their relative earnings upon entry) and selective return migration play an important role in determining whether repeated cross-sectional data over- or underestimate earnings assimilation.
papers.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们描述了1981年至2021年间移民工人收入同化的趋势。我们使用了包含工人在美国居住第一年及之后每年收入的行政纵向数据，使我们能够识别最终离开美国的移民（这里称为回流移民）。我们利用这些数据首次对41年期间的收入同化趋势进行了检验，并分别估算了回流移民与留在美国的移民的收入同化情况。我们记录了1981年至2010年间到达的移民的几个新事实。首先，大约五分之一到三分之一的移民在到达美国后10年内回流。其次，回流移民的初始收入与永久移民相似，但收入增长速度较慢。第三，自20世纪90年代中期以来到达的队列的收入同化相对较快：永久移民的收入在到达后10年内与本地出生者的收入趋于一致或接近一致。早期到达队列的移民经历了显著的收入增长，但通常没有与本地出生者的收入趋于一致。我们讨论了移民队列的劳动力市场质量变化（通过他们入境时的相对收入来衡量）和选择性回流移民在决定重复横截面数据是否高估或低估收入同化中所起的重要作用。

papers.title: Observability and Social Interactions in Consumption
papers.title_cn: 消费中的可观察性与社会互动
papers.abstract: Using a randomized survey experiment in the Italian Survey of Consumer Expectations, we study how observability and commonality shape responses to a €1,000 employer bonus. Making an idiosyncratic bonus observable to coworkers lowers the marginal propensity to consume by 3 percentage points. Conditional on observability, extending the bonus to all coworkers raises it by 6 percentage points. Under a social-interactions model, the latter effect implies a social-interaction parameter of 0.16 and a multiplier of 1.2. Thus, consumption responses depend not only on resources but also on whether income shocks are private, public, or shared within a salient peer group.
papers.abstract_cn: 在意大利消费者预期调查中，我们通过一项随机调查实验研究了可观察性和普遍性如何影响对1000欧元雇主奖金的回应。将个体特定的奖金对同事可见，会降低边际消费倾向3个百分点。在奖金可见的条件下，将其扩展到所有同事，则会提高6个百分点。根据社会互动模型，后者的效应意味着社会互动参数为0.16，乘数为1.2。因此，消费反应不仅取决于资源，还取决于收入冲击是私人的、公共的，还是在显著的同辈群体中共享的。

papers.title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-through into Consumer Prices
papers.title_cn: 关税传导至消费品价格的解剖分析
papers.abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax—an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly—tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawn-out impact on consumers than the direct effect alone would suggest.
papers.abstract_cn: 关税提高了国内制造商品的价格，而不仅仅是它们征税的进口商品——这一效应在标准传导估计中大多被忽略了。研究2025年美国的关税，我们发现大约26%的关税增长传导到了消费者价格。这些估计相对于暴露程度较低的商品进行测量，并将总体条件保持不变。直接效应占这种增长的64%，因为关税提高了商品外国品种的消费者价格。剩下的36%是间接产生的——关税提高了美国生产商使用的进口投入品的成本，国内生产商提高他们的价格加成，因为他们面临的来自价格更高的进口商品的竞争减少了。直接效应迅速传导，因为关税几乎立即提高了进口价格，但间接效应需要九到十二个月才能通过供应链发挥作用。因此，关税对消费者的影响比单独直接效应所暗示的更大、更持久。

papers.title: A Theory of Firm Wage Dynamics
papers.title_cn: 企业工资动态理论
papers.abstract: We develop a theory of firm wage dynamics that integrates the canonical wage-posting model à la Burdett and Mortensen (1998) with firm dynamics. Firms offer dynamic wage contracts under an equal-treatment constraint in the presence of search frictions. We provide an analytical characterization of equilibrium wage contracts and firm growth as functions only of the distribution of marginal surplus. Consistent with recent empirical evidence, the model implies that (i) firm wages are strongly linked to firm growth but not to firm size; (ii) firm wages decline over the firm life cycle; and (iii) the pass-through of permanent productivity shocks to wages is higher in the short run than in the long run. Firms at the top of the job ladder face excessive labor market competition, so the optimal policy subsidizes their hiring. At the macro level, the optimal policy elevates business dynamism in the steady state, and even more so along the transition.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个将经典工资发布模型（Burdett 和 Mortensen，1998）与企业动态相结合的企业工资动态理论。在存在搜索摩擦的情况下，企业在平等待遇约束下提供动态工资合同。我们提供了均衡工资合同和企业增长的分析特征，这些特征仅以边际剩余的分布为函数。与最近的实证证据一致，模型意味着：（i）企业工资与企业增长密切相关，但与企业规模无关；（ii）企业工资随着企业生命周期的推移而下降；（iii）永久性生产率冲击对工资的传导在短期内高于长期。处于职业阶梯顶端的企业面临过度的劳动力市场竞争，因此最优政策是补贴他们的招聘。在宏观层面，最优政策在稳态中提升了商业活力，并且在过渡期间更是如此。

papers.title: Unpacking Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in a Large-Scale Dropout-Prevention Experiment
papers.title_cn: 解析大规模辍学预防实验中的处理效应异质性
papers.abstract: Timely high school completion is a critical step in successful transitions to post-secondary schooling and the labor market. This randomized controlled trial, deployed in two urban, disadvantaged school districts, tests the effectiveness of a mature and comprehensive student-support program on an unusually large scale (n=2,528). While overall effects on graduation rates are small and statistically insignificant, exploratory analyses reveal notable variation by site and over time, mirroring heterogeneity in treatment timing and program implementation. These findings highlight the challenges of scaling interventions and raise concerns about generalizing results from small-scale, single-site evaluations.
papers.abstract_cn: 及时完成高中学业是成功过渡到高等教育和劳动力市场的关键一步。这项随机对照试验在两个城市贫困地区的学区进行，测试了一个成熟且全面的学生会支持计划在异常大规模（n=2,528）上的有效性。虽然对毕业率的整体影响小且统计上不显著，但探索性分析揭示了地点和时间上的显著变化，反映了治疗时机和项目实施的异质性。这些发现突出了扩大干预措施的挑战，并引发了对从小规模、单一地点评估中推广结果的担忧。

papers.title: Common Ownership and Collusion
papers.title_cn: 共同所有权与合谋
papers.abstract: We provide the first empirical evidence that common ownership can facilitate explicit collusion. Our unique setting, the population of legal cartels in Sweden, lets us observe cartel formation, duration, and dissolution without the sample-selection bias that plagues studies of detected cartels. Combining hand-collected ownership data with the universe of registered cartels, we compute firm-pair profit weights (κ) that measure how much one firm internalizes a rival's profits. Higher profit weights are associated with a greater likelihood of cartel participation, predict future cartel involvement, and are linked to longer cartel duration. Firms also reduce their profit weights immediately after a cartel dissolves. However, this relationship is concentrated among pairs in which the firm that internalizes the rival firm's profits colludes while the rival does not. Common ownership therefore complements a firm’s own participation in explicit collusion but substitutes for cartel participation by the rival whose profits it internalizes.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们首次提供了实证证据，表明共同所有权可以促进明确的合谋行为。我们独特的研究环境——瑞典的合法卡特尔群体——使我们能够观察到卡特尔的形成、持续时间和解散，而不受困扰已侦测卡特尔研究的样本选择偏差的影响。我们将手工收集的所有权数据与注册卡特尔的全集结合起来，计算了企业对利润权重（κ），这一指标衡量了一个企业在多大程度上内化了竞争对手的利润。更高的利润权重与参与卡特尔的可能性更大相关，可以预测未来的卡特尔参与，并且与更长的卡特尔持续时间相关联。企业在卡特尔解散后立即降低其利润权重。然而，这种关系集中在那些内化竞争对手利润的企业合谋而竞争对手不参与的配对中。因此，共同所有权补充了企业自身参与明确合谋的行为，但替代了它内化利润的竞争对手的卡特尔参与。

papers.title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
papers.title_cn: 在事件发展中识别关键转折点：基于120年报告的基础、测量与应用
papers.abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
papers.abstract_cn: 解释为何一些国家能够变得富裕而其他国家仍然贫穷，需要了解制度如何以及何时发生变化。大量研究认为，制度变化经常发生在关键时刻：在这些时刻，多种制度未来都有可能出现，包括回归现状。然而，大多数实证工作仅在事后考察关键时刻，这可能会遗漏制度处于变动之中但最终未发生改变的关键时期。我们开发了一种新的实证方法来实时检测关键时刻。我们的关键洞见是将关键时刻理解为对制度的不确定性时刻，这为文本分类器提供了一个理论上有动机的目标，用于在当代话语中检测。在本章中，我们将这一理念应用于历史关键时刻的研究，使用报纸文本作为关于当代对制度不确定性信念的丰富信息源。我们将这种洞见转化为一种测量策略，通过训练一个基于大型语言模型的分类器，将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案——涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章——同时将我们的主要实证分析集中在1900年至2019年的120年报道上。这产生了第一个基于关键时刻概念的长期、基于文本的制度不确定性度量。与已建立的地缘政治和经济风险指数相比，我们的度量在几个方面进行了创新：（i）即使在没有正式制度变化的时期，它也能捕捉到高不确定性，与关键时刻的ex-ante定义一致；（ii）它为重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）提供了更早的信号；（iii）它使用一个共同的ex-ante度量来评估候选关键时刻；以及（iv）它为研究关键时刻如何塑造制度和长期发展开辟了新途径。今天，我们基于《泰晤士报》的指数表明，美国和英国的制度不确定性与20世纪40年代初一样高——这是其他领先风险度量所错过的信号。

papers.title: Time Travel on Professional Profiles
papers.title_cn: 职业档案中的时间旅行
papers.abstract: Economists increasingly use professional profile data to reconstruct employment histories and measure skill supply. We show that these records are not fixed historical snapshots, but mutable accounts that workers revise over time. Using monthly vintages of Revelio Labs data from 2020–2026, we document that 19.7 percent of established U.S. LinkedIn users retroactively edit the title or description of a job they have already left. These “time-travel” edits are closely tied to labor market transitions: around such edits, workers are much more likely to change employers as compared to later-editing users. This mutability can bias historical measures of skills, but it also reveals workers’ beliefs about which skills are in demand. Retroactive edits show sharp post-2022 increases in AI-related language and recent reductions in work-from-home and DEI language. Finally, LLM-associated writing markers surge after ChatGPT, especially among less-educated groups and MBAs from lower-ranked programs, revealing heterogeneous AI-assisted profile editing.
papers.abstract_cn: 经济学家越来越多地使用职业档案数据来重建就业历史和衡量技能供给。我们展示这些记录并非固定的历叐快照，而是工人随时间修订的可变账户。利用2020至2026年间Revelio Labs数据的月度版本，我们记录到19.7%的美国LinkedIn用户对他们已经离开的职位的头衔或描述进行了追溯性编辑。这些“穿越时空”的编辑与劳动力市场转换密切相关：与这些编辑相比，工人更有可能更换雇主，而不是后来编辑的用户。这种可变性可能会对技能的历史测量产生偏差，但它也揭示了工人对哪些技能有需求的信念。追溯性编辑显示，2022年后与人工智能相关的语言急剧增加，而在家工作和DEI（多样性、平等与包容）语言最近有所减少。最后，与大型语言模型（LLM）相关的写作标记在ChatGPT之后激增，特别是在受教育程度较低的群体和排名较低的MBA项目中，揭示了异质的人工智能辅助个人资料编辑。

papers.title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
papers.title_cn: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
papers.abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.
papers.abstract_cn: 金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为了研究金融相互依存下既有大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个具有微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。货币专业中介机构存在的搜索摩擦在资产市场和货币区域层面产生了不同的流动性概念，这两者共同塑造了货币竞争的轨迹。在美国-中国的背景下，中国在金融发展的早期阶段从将其资产与美元区域合并中获益，这加强了现状。随着中国金融市场的深化，人民币发行使中国能够内部化网络效应，侵蚀美元的主导地位，引发向分裂的离散转变。这一转变进一步受到制裁、金融压制和第三国反应的影响，突出了金融相互依存如何在国际金融秩序的演变中将合作转变为竞争。

papers.title: Chinese Sputnik Moments?
papers.title_cn: 中国的斯普特尼克时刻？
papers.abstract: China’s technological progress in recent decades has been viewed with admiration, alarm, and (in some cases) doubt. To better understand the Chinese innovation ecosystem, we compile a dataset of almost 14 million domestic Chinese patent publications. We focus on the subset of critical technologies identified by the U.S. Department of Defense. Several surprising patterns emerge from the data: Chinese patenting is strongly associated with other measures of innovative progress; patents are not concentrated in corporate giants such as Huawei; universities have played a key role in innovation, much greater than state-owned enterprises or government-owned facilities; and fewer than one in ten Chinese critical technology patents involves an inventor with U.S. experience or training. Finally, using four text-based measures of patent quality, we show that the rise of Chinese patenting in critical technologies has not been associated with a decline in quality relative to the U.S. awards.
papers.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，中国的技术进步引起了钦佩、警觉，甚至在某些情况下还有怀疑。为了更好地理解中国的创新生态系统，我们编制了一个包含近1400万份中国国内专利出版物的数据集。我们专注于美国国防部确定的关键技术子集。数据中出现了几个令人惊讶的模式：中国的专利申请与其它创新进展的衡量指标密切相关；专利并不集中在华为等企业巨头手中；大学在创新中发挥了关键作用，其作用远大于国有企业或政府拥有的设施；而且不到十分之一的中国关键技术专利涉及具有美国经验或培训的发明人。最后，使用四种基于文本的专利质量衡量指标，我们表明中国在关键技术领域的专利申请上升并没有伴随着与美国授予的专利相比质量的下降。

papers.title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
papers.title_cn: 模糊归因：理论与证据
papers.abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents’ partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
papers.abstract_cn: 责任明确性是政治问责制的一个基本要素。我们构建了一个在模糊归因情况下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并使用一项原创调查来测试其预测。我们发现，受访者的党派身份、对公共医疗质量的评估以及对哪一层政府负责医疗保健的信念，如预测所示是相关的：对医疗质量评价高的选民将责任归咎于他们偏好的政党所控制的政府层级，而评价低的选民则将责任归咎于他们不喜欢的政党所控制的政府层级。这些党派性的赞誉和指责模式，通常被解释为动机推理或党派偏见的证据，因此可能源于在归因模糊性下的理性贝叶斯更新。在同一个政党同时控制区域和中央政府的情况下，不存在这样的党派模式。我们进行的一项调查实验中，当告知受访者官方医疗质量时，他们按照预测的党派方向更新信念。模型和实证结果表明，在归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被动摇。

papers.title: Selecting Innovation Funding Mechanisms: A Framework for Policymakers
papers.title_cn: 选择创新资助机制：为政策制定者提供的框架
papers.abstract: The U.S. federal government spends roughly $150 billion a year on research and development through mechanisms ranging from grants and contracts to prizes, advance market commitments, and tax credits. These funding mechanisms differ markedly in risk allocation, decision authority, and incentive power, yet policymakers have little systematic guidance for choosing among them. We develop a framework that asks the policymaker three initial questions about the contracting environment: Can they articulate the work to be done? Can they specify what would constitute a successful solution? Can they identify the most capable performers to contract with? The answers considerably narrow the set of viable mechanisms, enabling a more tractable choice of the efficient mechanism based on further considerations from the innovation-economics literature.
papers.abstract_cn: 美国联邦政府每年通过各种机制在研究与开发上投入约1500亿美元，这些机制包括从赠款、合同到奖励、预先市场承诺和税收抵免等。这些资金机制在风险分配、决策权限和激励力度方面存在显著差异，然而政策制定者在选择它们时几乎没有系统的指导。我们开发了一个框架，要求政策制定者回答三个关于合同环境的初始问题：他们能否明确要完成的工作？他们能否具体说明什么构成成功的解决方案？他们能否识别出最有能力的执行者来签订合同？这些答案大大缩小了可行机制的范围，使得基于创新经济学文献中进一步考虑的更易处理的高效机制选择成为可能。

papers.title: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
papers.title_cn: 将激励与信息挂钩：医疗保健中基于诊断的合同与偏见信念
papers.abstract: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.
papers.abstract_cn: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对其健康状况的信念与实际情况之间的差距；人们经常寻求并消费他们怀疑自己患有的疾病的治疗，但实际上并不知道自己是否真的患有这些疾病。因此，患者对检测的价值取决于他们对生病的先验信念，当这些信念存在偏差时，由此产生的检测率可能是次优的，并且会留下未被利用的福利。我们研究了与诊断结果挂钩的激励合同，这些合同将治疗激励与诊断结果联系起来。对于疟疾，该合同只为检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断检测（RDT）和抗疟药物（ACT）。在肯尼亚140家药店进行的群组随机实验中，患者补贴和供应商激励使检测率大致增加了三倍，并显著减少了检测阴性患者不必要的ACT购买，这些效果通过不同的渠道发挥作用：患者补贴通过降低价格，供应商激励通过提供信息和建议。患者选择模型意味着这些合同将社会福利提高到了远高于其成本的水平。通过结构性估计该模型，我们发现由于患者大幅高估了他们的感染风险，将激励加载到基于诊断的治疗方案折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测计划的四倍。

papers.title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
papers.title_cn: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融
papers.abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文综述了金融知识方面的文献。它涵盖了最初创建的“三大问题”以及包含28个问题的个人理财知识测量。研究表明，金融知识水平较低，且随时间没有改善。这不仅在美国如此，全球各国也是如此。这些发现很重要，因为金融知识有助于精明的金融行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，再到许多其他金融决策。金融教育项目随时间呈指数级增长，为它们的成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已纳入高中和大学课程，证据表明，它们是提高金融知识和后续行为的有益举措。

papers.title: Long-Run Effects of H-1B Immigration on the U.S. Economy
papers.title_cn: H-1B 移民对美国经济的长期影响
papers.abstract: We study the effects of H-1B immigration on U.S. industries that employ H-1B workers and their trading partners. Using a novel cross-industry design and the 1999–2003 expansion of the H-1B visa cap for identification, we find that H-1B exposure raised incomes for natives and pre-existing immigrants, with gains concentrated in non-STEM occupations. Income gains propagate forward through supply chains to downstream industries but not backward to upstream industries, consistent with a productivity shock rather than a labor supply shock. We find no direct effect on patenting, suggesting that productivity gains arise from better task execution rather than patentable invention.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们研究了H-1B移民对雇佣H-1B工作者的美国行业及其贸易伙伴的影响。利用1999-2003年H-1B签证上限扩大这一新颖的跨行业设计进行识别，我们发现H-1B的暴露提高了本地人和现有移民的收入，且收益集中在非STEM职业中。收入增长通过供应链向前传递到下游行业，但并未向后传递到上游行业，这与生产率冲击而非劳动力供给冲击一致。我们发现对专利申请没有直接影响，这表明生产率的提高来自于更好的任务执行，而非可专利的发明。

papers.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
papers.title_cn: 行为政策的价值
papers.abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing “nudges” and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.
papers.abstract_cn: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心，但其经验效果仍存在争议，因为估计的处理效应往往看似较小。我们认为，只有相对于替代政策产生的反应，政策反应才具有经济意义。我们从超过600项研究中收集了1200多个估计值，比较了在香烟、酒精、流感疫苗、电力和住宅用水市场中“轻推”和传统价格干预的效果。将轻推效应转化为等效的价格变化，我们发现行为干预往往对应着巨大的财政干预，从电力的11%税收到流感疫苗的100%补贴。在所有市场中，轻推也比价格工具更具成本效益，但成本效益并不能预测政策的福利排名。使用公共基金边际价值的行为扩展，我们展示了轻推在边际上具有高福利回报，而价格工具在规模上往往产生更大的总剩余。

papers.title: Childhood Cognitive and Behavioral Impairments and Adult Health
papers.title_cn: 儿童认知和行为障碍与成人健康
papers.abstract: We use U.S. nationally representative longitudinal data to estimate the effects of cognitive and behavioral impairments in childhood on health in adulthood. We focus on work-limiting health conditions and fair or poor self-rated health but also consider adequacy of sleep, body weight, and health behaviors (use of various substances and preventive health care) as potential pathways. In household fixed effects models, we find that both impairments are strongly associated with having a work-limiting health condition in adulthood; specifically, cognitive impairments increase the probability of a work-limiting condition by 70% and behavioral impairments increase the probability by 60%.
